common.note: Identifies the status of the compressor a (0 - ready; 1 - safety trip 1; 2 - safety trip 2; 3 - comp on; 4 - low pressure lockout; 5 - inhibited; 6 - safety lockout; 7 off ascd; 8 - user disabled).

common.name: Comp Sys B Status
common.note: Identifies the status of the compressor b (0 - ready; 1 - safety trip 1; 2 - safety trip 2; 3 - comp on; 4 - low pressure lockout; 5 - inhibited; 6 - safety lockout; 7 off ascd; 8 - user disabled).

common.name: Comp Sys C Status
common.note: Identifies the status of the compressor c (0 - ready; 1 - safety trip 1; 2 - safety trip 2; 3 - comp on; 4 - low pressure lockout; 5 - inhibited; 6 - safety lockout; 7 off ascd; 8 - user disabled).

common.name: Comp Sys D Status
common.note: Identifies the status of the compressor d (0 - ready; 1 - safety trip 1; 2 - safety trip 2; 3 - comp on; 4 - low pressure lockout; 5 - inhibited; 6 - safety lockout; 7 off ascd; 8 - user disabled).

common.name: Comp Sys E Status
common.note: Identifies the status of the compressor e (0 - ready; 1 - safety trip 1; 2 - safety trip 2; 3 - comp on; 4 - low pressure lockout; 5 - inhibited; 6 - safety lockout; 7 off ascd; 8 - user disabled).

common.name: Comp Sys F Status
common.note: Identifies the status of the compressor f (0 - ready; 1 - safety trip 1; 2 - safety trip 2; 3 - comp on; 4 - low pressure lockout; 5 - inhibited; 6 - safety lockout; 7 off ascd; 8 - user disabled).

common.name: Cond Bypass Max Pos
common.note: The maximum allowable opening for the by- pass valve (%)

common.name: Cond Valves Install
common.note: Identifies the condenser valve installed (0 = none; 1 = cond only; 2 = cond w/bypass)

common.name: Cond Valve Min Pos
common.note: The minimum allowable opening for the con- denser water valve (%)

common.name: Cond Water Control
common.note: Identifies the status of the condenser water control ( 0 = dis; 1 = ena)

common.name: Cond Water Flow
common.note: Identifies if the unit is configured for a water flow switch (0 = none; 1 = installed)

common.name: Cond Water Valve
common.note: Shows the position of the condenser water valve (%)

common.name: Condenser Pressure PI Output
common.note: This is a derived value that identifies the output demand to the condenser water valve (%)

common.name: Condenser Type
common.note: This identifies the type of condenser installed in the unit (0 = water cooled; 1 = air cooled)

common.name: Duct Static Pres RST
common.note: A hardwired entered analog voltage that results in a %reset down from the duct static high limit based on a percent of the difference between duct static high limit and duct static low limit (%)

common.name: Duct Static Pres 1
common.note: Actual duct static pressure input from trans- ducer 1 to the control (“WG)

common.name: Duct Static Pres 2
common.note: Actual duct static pressure input from trans- ducer 2 to the control (“WG)

common.name: Dew Point Reset
common.note: This allows the dew point reset feature to be turned on and off on flexsys units (0 = off / 1 = on)

common.name: Duct Static High Setp
common.note: The duct static upper set point (“WG)

common.name: Duct Static Low Setp
common.note: The duct static lower set point (“WG)

common.name: Duct Static Pres RST BAS
common.note: A bas entered value that results in a %reset down from the duct static high limit based on a percent of the difference between duct static high limit and duct static low limit (%). DUCT PRES RST BAS must be enabled using the service key in order to use this feature

common.name: Economizer Installed
common.note: Allows the economizer feature to be turned on and off (0 = off / 1 = on)

common.name: Economizer Method Active
common.note: The economizer method being used by the control (1 - dry bulb; 2 - single enthalpy; 3 - dual enthalpy; 4 - best method; 5 - water)

common.name: Economizer Method
common.note: The economizer method selected for use (0 - dry bulb; 1- single enthalpy; 2 - dual enthalpy; 3 - best method)

common.name: Econo Sys Status
common.note: Status of the economizer option (0 - installed and inactive; 1 - installed and active; 2 - not installed; 3 - disabled)

common.name: Evap Leaving Air Temp High
common.note: On a flexsys unit with bypass this is the supply air temperature high set point (F)

common.name: Evap Leaving Air Temp Low
common.note: On a flexsys unit with bypass this is the supply air temperature low set point (F)

common.name: Filter Status
common.note: Identifies the status of the binary dirty filter input (nfl - no fault; flt - faulted)

common.name: Electric Heat Stage 1
common.note: Identifies the status of the binary output to the indicated heating section (off / on)

common.name: Electric Heat Stage 2
common.note: Identifies the status of the binary output to the indicated heating section (off / on)

common.name: Electric Heat Stage 3
common.note: Identifies the status of the binary output to the indicated heating section (off / on)

common.name: Electric Heat Stage 4
common.note: Identifies the status of the binary output to the indicated heating section (off / on)

common.name: Flex Evap Temp Current
common.note: Actual temperature of air leaving the evapora- tor coil on a flexsys unit (F)

common.name: Heating Sat
common.note: The heating sat set point for a vav or flexsys unit (F)

common.name: Electric Heat Stages
common.note: Derived value showing the number of electric or staged gas heat stages available (1 - 7)

common.name: Heating System
common.note: A communicated input that allows the heating function to be turned on and off (0 = enabled; 1 = disabled)

common.name: Heating System Status
common.note: Identifies the status of the heat (0 - normal in- active; 1 - normal active; 2 - none; 3 - disabled; 4 - normal; 5 - warning; 6 - safety trip; 7 safety fault; 8 - safety lockout; 9 - air tempering))

common.name: Heating Valve
common.note: The output from the control to a hot water, steam, or modulating gas heat valve (%)

common.name: Heating Valve Action
common.note: A communicated input that allows the heating valve action to be changed (0 = direct acting; 1 = reverse acting)

common.name: Hot Water FRZ Status
common.note: The status of the freezestat circuit on units with hot water or steam heat. (Flt - faulted / nfl - no fault)

common.name: Local Stop
common.note: Identifies the status of the hardwired binary input of the local stop (run / stp - stop)

common.name: Mixed Air Temp
common.note: The temperature of the air entering the evapo- rator coil

common.name: Mixed Sat Limit
common.note: On a flexsys unit this is the supply air setpoint when operating without a bypass damper (f)

common.note: A communicated input that allows morning warm up to be turned on and off (0 = enabled; 1 = disabled)

common.name: Morning Warm Up CMND
common.note: A bas generated command to allow the morn- ing warm up feature to be turned on and off (0 = off / 1 = on)

common.name: Night Set Back (for Heating)
common.note: This command allows the night set back heat- ing function to be turned on and off (0 = off / 1 = on)

common.name: OA Damper
common.note: This is the position of the outdoor damper (%)

common.note: Identifies the status of the hardwired binary input (ENA - enabled - occupied; DIS - disabled unoccupied)

common.name: Outside Air Humidity
common.note: Actual outdoor air relative humidity (%)

common.note: Actual outdoor air temperature (F)

common.name: Sat Low Setpoint

common.name: SF Speed for Low Sat
common.note: The fan speed the control uses when using supply fan speed sat reset to switch to the sat low limit set point (%)

common.note: Identifies if a vfd bypass is installed. DIS = installed ENA = not installed

common.name: SF VFD Bypass Mode
common.note: This gives the status of the vfd bypass mode (0 = VFD active; 1 = VFD bypassed)

common.name: STG 1 Heating

common.name: STG 2 Cooling

common.name: STG 2 Heating

common.name: Supply Air Temp

common.note: The status of the binary output from the con- troller to the supply fan circuit (on / off)

common.name: System Stop
common.note: A 0- value allows all compressors to operate; 1 - turns off compressor system 1; 2 - turns off compressor system 2; 3 - turns off compressor system 3

common.name: Supply Sys Status
common.note: Identifies the status of the supply system (0 - normal inactive; 1 - normal active; 2 - none; 3 - disabled; 4 - normal; 5 - warning; 6 - safety trip; 7 safety fault; 8 - safety lockout)

common.name: Under Floor Dew Point
common.note: The calculated dew point of the air under the floor in a flexsys system (%)

common.note: This allows the bas system to input a under floor humidity value to the control on a FLEX- SYS system (%) UNDER FLR HUMI BAS must be enabled using the service key in order to use this feature

common.name: Under Floor Humidity
common.note: Humidity value of the air under the fol or the con- trol is controlling to in a FLEXSYS system (%)

common.note: This allows the bas system to input a under floor temperature value to the control on a flexsys system (F). UNDER FLR TEMP BAS must be enabled using the service key in order to use this feature

common.name: Under Floor Temp
common.note: Temperature of the air under the floor the con- trol is controlling to in a FLEXSYS system (F)

common.name: Unit Mode
common.note: 0 - Occupied cooling

common.name: Unit Overall Status
common.note: Identifies the unit overall status (0 - Normal Inactive; 1 - Normal Active; 2 - None; 3 - Dis- abled; 4 - Normal; 5 - Warning; 6 - Safety Trip; 7 Safety Fault; 8 - Safety Lockout)

common.name: Unit Stop
common.note: This command allows the unit to be shut down through the bas system (0 = Normal Operation/ 1 = Stopped

common.name: Unoccupied Zone Cooling
common.note: The unoccupied zone cooling set point (F)

common.name: Unoccupied Zone Heating
common.note: The unoccupied zone heating set point (F)

common.name: Ventilation Control

common.name: Vav Heat

common.name: Vent Sys Status
common.note: Identifies the status of the ventilation system (0 - Normal Inactive; 1 - Normal Active; 2 - None; 3 - Disabled; 4 - Normal; 5 - Warning; 6 - Safety Trip; 7 Safety Fault; 8 - Safety Lockout)

common.note: This item is used in the determination of when water side economizer becomes active (F)

common.name: Water Econo Min Pos
common.note: The minimum allowable opening for the water economizer valve (%)

common.name: Water Flow Switch
common.note: Identifies if a water flow switch is installed ENA = Not Installed DIS = Installed

common.name: Water Temp Entering
common.note: The temperature of the condenser water enter- ing the unit

common.name: Water Temp Leaving
common.note: The temperature of the condenser water leav- ing the unit

common.name: Zone Temp Bas
common.note: This allows the bas system to input a zone temperature value to the control on a constant volume unit with communicated zone control (F)

common.name: Zone Temp
